topic: UPI Micro Spends & Daily Money Leakage
caption:
Daily ₹50-₹100 ka UPI payment chhota lagta hai, par month end par wallet khaali kar deta hai!

Is silent money leak ko pehchano aur apni hard-earned money ko useless micro-expenses se bachao.
Small daily discipline = Big yearly savings!

Tum din mein average kitni baar UPI scan karte ho? Comment mein batao!

Follow karo @ctrl_thoughts_ for daily finance ideas.

Sirf educational purpose ke liye hai, financial advice nahi hai.
